text:
Renee (PM): Short design review: compact prompt-set diffs need better discoverability for regressions, clearer CTA language (avoid snapshot ambiguity), and keyboard/screenreader guidance for the run scrubber. Mock: https://img.redwood.company/ux/compact-diffs-v2.png

Ivy (Design): Two quick problems I see: the regression badge disappears at high density and users don't notice baseline rows. Proposal: 1) add a slim left baseline marker, 2) pair color with a pattern for colorblind mode, 3) show a tiny sparkline + numeric density. Keep legend collapsible to save space.

Hector (Frontend): All doable. Implementation constraints: list is virtualized, so legend must live outside the list. For keyboard users we need a focus-triggered metadata panel (Enter to toggle) rather than hover-only. Hotkeys suggestion: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight for scrubber, 'n'/'p' for next/prev regression, and 'b' to open baseline modal.

Zoe (UX Research): In five remote tests, "Set baseline" + one-line subtext beat "Snapshot" and "Promote" for clarity. Users liked an immediate undo affordance (toast with Undo) more than scary modal copy. Also the scrubber needs explicit SR announcements: e.g., "Run 7: 3 regressions, medium density."

infra-bot: Deploy note: if we add sparkline SVGs, ensure assets are served from CDN and placeholder falls back to numeric text.\
a11y-bot: Accessibility checks: regression badge contrast fails on light theme at small sizes (WCAG AA). Suggestions: use tokenized colors (#0F4A72 on #EAF8FF) or add a 1.5px outline. Add patterned SVG backgrounds for colorblind mode and ensure patterns are not solely decorative (include titles). Scrubber: use role=\"slider\" and support Arrow/Home/End; provide aria-live region that announces run summary on change. Toast: role=status and make Undo focusable.

Ivy (Design): Microcopy draft for modal (short): "Set current outputs as the baseline for this prompt set. Future runs will be compared against these outputs. You can revert from baseline history." Toast copy: "Baseline set. Undo". I'll mock the legend + pattern badges and the slim baseline marker.

Hector (Frontend): Quick prototype plan:
- Lazy-render sparkline on focus to avoid perf overhead.
- Add aria-live region with id=\"sr-live\" and update on scrubber change.
- Implement hotkeys and focus return after modal close.
Snippet: ```js
const live = document.getElementById('sr-live');
function announce(runLabel, regCount, density) {
  live.textContent = `${runLabel}: ${regCount} regressions, ${density} density`;
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'n') nextReg(); if (e.key === 'p') prevReg(); });
```

Zoe (UX Research): I'll run 6 quick follow-ups once Ivy posts updated mocks to validate legend discoverability and toast reaction.

Renee (PM): Action items:
- Ivy: updated mock with left marker, legend, pattern badges, sparkline + numeric density, and modal + toast copy by Wed EOD.
- Hector: prototype hotkeys + aria-live demo next Tue; lazy-render sparkline.
- Zoe: 6 follow-up sessions after mock update.
- infra-bot: confirm CDN placeholder for sparkline asset.

If you can't make the sync Thu 9am PT, drop :raised_hand: here. Otherwise we'll aim to ship compact improvements in the next minor release.
